method: Read697 additional source lines across worker publication, message receivers and query dispatch. Static ordering/ownership analysis; no Windows runtime.
findings: Narrowing v37: delivered search and AI payloads are reclaimed with Box::from_raw before state/query validation, and OCR reclaims its nonzero payload before state check. Discarding a delivered stale result therefore frees memory. Failed PostMessage publication still has no recovery in reviewed senders.

Fast and slow worker threads independently post results for same query id. Receiver accepts every nonempty nonfinal result even after final response for that id; no final-received generation state is checked. A late fast response can replace full content/OCR results. Static scheduling mechanism; not runtime-reproduced.

OCR result receiver has no query/request generation or active-operation guard: delivered result assigns s.query and triggers search. User edits or overlapping OCR operations can be overwritten by older completion. Sender wp is zero. No clipboard/OCR operations run.

Search receivers validate query id and discard after query cleared. Workers coalesce queued requests before each computation but do not cancel in-flight computation. This prevents stale-query publication but not wasted ongoing work or same-id fast/slow regression.

Search request sends ignore disconnected-channel errors after setting search_loading true. No recovery or loading reset on send failure appears in trigger_search. Prefix queries skip fast worker by design, narrowing earlier blank-result issue.

AI response filtering uses chat id and pending state rather than per-request generation; multiple outstanding requests in same chat can satisfy same acceptance test. Request serialization/cancellation elsewhere remains unread, so reachability is unqualified.

Payload packs query id into lower32bits and final marker above32bits; receiver compares unpacked id to full current_query_id. Long-run wrap behavior requires type/overflow/caller review; no wrap fixture run.

Animation code separates result-area invalidation from search-row invalidation and relaxes timer to80ms once growth finishes but loading remains. Useful responsiveness reference; no measured performance acceptance.
Lens launch hides launcher and calls DwmFlush before screen capture, so review must not claim it always captures visible launcher. Actual timing/hardware output remains untested.
limits: 85/268 whole files. main.rs partial ranges only; unreviewed gaps remain.
No new tests or local production edits; race mechanisms are source findings, not integrated reproductions.
